authorizations.evidence: Groq documents the free tier as rate-limited only; billing begins solely after the operator explicitly upgrades to the Developer tier or crosses a published spend threshold, so a free-tier key cannot silently incur cost.
Cerebras documents that the Free Trial tier stops API access when credits are exhausted rather than billing; there is no charge until the operator purchases additional credits.

The Claude CLI executes under the operator's existing authenticated Claude subscription. Marginal per-invocation cost is zero; the cost figures the CLI reports are list-basis attribution for usage accounting, not a charge against this repository.

The Codex CLI executes under the operator's existing authenticated ChatGPT/Codex subscription. Marginal per-invocation cost is zero; the subscription enforces its own usage limits and refuses rather than billing this repository.

nonClaims: This file records the operator's explicit economic authorization for a transport and provider pair. It does not assert an observed account tier, balance, subscription state, paid-usage history or overage entitlement, and it is not provider-returned evidence.
Absence of an authorization for a transport and provider pair makes that pair economically ineligible; eligibility is never inferred.

A subscription-included authorization asserts only that the operator's existing subscription covers invocation and that no per-call charge accrues to this repository. It asserts no remaining subscription quota; the transport refuses when its own limit is reached.
